description: This file defines a lightweight, flexible Swift struct called `AnyCodable` which conforms to `Codable`, `Hashable`, and `@unchecked Sendable`. It provides functionality to handle heterogeneous JSON payloads by wrapping various data types, including dictionaries and arrays, enabling seamless encoding and decoding of arbitrary JSON data. The struct normalizes values and supports comparison and hashing for heterogeneous types.

classes.name: AnyCodable
classes.description: A lightweight, flexible Codable wrapper that can encapsulate heterogeneous JSON payloads, supporting encode/decode, comparison, and hashing.

methods.name: init(_ value: Any)
methods.description: Initializes an `AnyCodable` instance with a value of any type, normalizing the value for boolean types.

methods.name: init(from decoder: Decoder) throws
methods.description: Decodes a value from the given decoder, attempting to decode supported types in order.

methods.name: encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws
methods.description: Encodes the wrapped value to the given encoder, supporting various supported types including dictionaries and arrays.

methods.name: == (lhs: AnyCodable, rhs: AnyCodable) -> Bool
methods.description: Equality comparison between two `AnyCodable` instances based on their underlying values.

methods.name: hash(into hasher: inout Hasher)
methods.description: Feeds the hash of the underlying value into the hasher, supporting multiple supported types.
